name: Cave of Origin
lines: You can hear a voice from within the Magma Suit!

Maxie: It is I, the great Maxie.
Maxie: A device built into that suit you
have donned allows me to talk to you.

Maxie: We have received the readings from your
suit. They suggest that Groudon has appeared.
Maxie: Is my supposition correct?
Does it stand before you now?

Maxie: You must listen...
Do not waste even a single second.
Leap upon Groudon’s mighty back.
Maxie: Then le— take you to— dee—est...
o— th— c...
